def test_usd_payee_with_comma_is_quoted_and_matches_the_header():
    import csv
    import io

    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    assert text.splitlines()[1] == 'chk-100,2024-06-02,"Smith, Jones LLP",12.50,retainer'
    header, row = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    assert len(row) == len(header)
    assert row == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]


def test_quotes_and_newlines_in_memo_round_trip():
    import csv
    import io

    memo = 'said "hi"\nthen left'
    text = export_statement([Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Acme", 1, memo, "USD")])
    header, row = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    assert row[4] == memo
EOF
